names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Ιουλίου, «Όσιος Συμεών ο Νεοφανής, Θεσσαλονικεύς», with the rank word and the two bynames left off. The page glosses the name as a Hebrew word meaning the one who loves his fellow men.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Συμεών γεννήθηκε στη Θεσσαλονίκη το 1042 μ.Χ. στα χρόνια της αυτοκράτειρας Ζωής». The page heads him «(1042 - ;)» and gives no year of death.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is not the corpus's `symeon-of-thessalonica`, who is the archbishop of that city kept on 15 September and already carries a venerated Greek row for that day; this man is an eleventh-century hermit of the Egyptian Thebaid, born 1042, and the two are a bishop and a cave-dweller four centuries apart. He is none of the corpus's other men of the name either — Metaphrastes, of Mega Spileo, of Pângărați, of Persia, of Tver, the New Theologian, the New of Mytilene — none of whom is kept on 24 July. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn and no distich.
